description: Shows at a glance which threads work, wait for you, failed or finished, even in collapsed project folders. Each row keeps the icon of its AI with a status dot on its corner, and every folder shows a rollup left of its count. Project folders become cards with a sticky header; threads sort by their latest turn, and each card shows its 5 freshest threads behind Show N more. The folder of the open thread is outlined, and colors follow the active bb theme in light and dark mode. Requires the Thread Tree plugin.
